# v1.14.0

## Installable PWA + Web Push (no Apple account needed for iOS)

The web app is now a **Progressive Web App**: on an iPhone it installs to the home
screen (Safari → Share → *Na početni ekran*) and runs full-screen like a native
app — with **real push notifications** on iOS 16.4+. Because nothing is signed by
Apple, **nothing can expire**: no developer account, no renewals, no resigning,
no 90-day TestFlight leash. Updates arrive simply by reopening the app after a
server deploy.

## What's new

- **PWA shell:** `manifest.webmanifest` (standalone display, brand background,
  icons), iOS meta tags (apple-touch-icon, status bar), favicon, and an offline
  fallback page. Generated PWA icons (regular + maskable, 192/512) derive from
  the committed launcher artwork; maskable icons scale the foreground into the
  72 % safe zone over the `#070C20` brand background.
- **Service worker (`sw.js`):** network-first with an offline fallback, never
  caches `/api/` or HTML responses (live data always wins), `no-cache` header
  pinned for `/sw.js` in nginx so updates roll out immediately. Push messages
  render as system notifications; tapping one focuses the app and opens the
  pushed board (cold-start taps deep-link via `/?board=<id>`).
- **Web Push backend (VAPID):** new `push_subscriptions` table + endpoints —
  `GET /api/me/webpush/vapid` (public key for `pushManager.subscribe`),
  `POST /api/me/webpush/subscribe` / `/unsubscribe` (endpoint-unique upsert; a
  browser moving accounts takes its row with it), `POST /api/me/webpush/test`
  (real test push to all of the account's subscriptions, prunes 404/410 rows).
  The instance **auto-generates and persists its VAPID key pair** on first use
  (settings table — zero-config, survives restarts; `pywebpush` + `py-vapid`
  pinned). Delivery goes to the browser vendor's push service (FCM endpoints
  for Chrome/Android, Apple's for Safari/iOS) — no Firebase/Apple setup.
- **Channel model:** web push is now its own channel, sent *in addition* to
  FCM/ntfy in `notify_task_users` (a PWA subscriber may not own the
  FCM-registered phone). The 90-second duplicate-collapse guard already covers
  the combined fan-out.
- **Obavijesti UI:** a new "Obavijesti na uređaju" card on the web — shows
  subscription state, *Omogući obavijesti* (permission prompt + subscribe),
  *Testiraj* (server-side test push), *Isključi na ovom uređaju*; guidance for
  the iPhone "Add to Home Screen" step; a one-tap install prompt on
  Android/desktop when the browser offers one.

## Notes

- Backend requirements add `pywebpush==2.5.0` and `py-vapid==1.9.4` (cryptography
  arrives transitively). No API was renamed — everything is additive per the
  frozen-contract rule. Mobile app unchanged in this release (CI still builds a
  version-aligned APK).
- iOS push requires the app to be installed on the home screen (Apple's rule,
  iOS 16.4+) and served over HTTPS — the production instance already is.
- Verified: backend `py_compile`, **7/7 pytest** (VAPID persistence, subscribe
  upsert/move, delivery + 410-pruning with a stubbed pusher, additive channel
  order, full HTTP flow), `node --check` on both JS files, manifest JSON valid,
  both compose files valid.
